ns2:Work.dc:description: Synthetic curved saddle point cloud; 24 nearest neighbors by Euclidean distance. Plane through neighborhood centroid; normal is the smallest-eigenvalue eigenvector of the actual 3D neighborhood covariance. PCA sign fixed by positive world Z.
